pet_slot_policy: L2 input is the L1 skill_bar crop. Scan both dedicated pet active slots in crop-normalized coordinates; never bind a restore skill to a fixed slot index.
player_hotkey_policy: Only the bottom row with visible hotkeys is eligible for cooldown/release logic.
cd_policy: Cooldown is decided by gray-overlay/digit features inside the matched slot, not by template score.
failure_policy: Return unknown and do not click when identity or cooldown state is unknown.
